name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The sentence 'If you pick up the key, you must also open the door' is a conditional rule with 'must also', so the hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is the correct template. has_door_key grounds the key pickup, the condition gets no Existence, and the door opening is a consequent rather than a goal. The rule-only warning is valid because the task is purely conditional. The machine owes door_open after has_door_key and discharges it on door_open.

texts: If the agent has the matching door key, it must also open the door at some point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
